hero.title: Nobody knows your olive grove better than you.
hero.definition: Your grove’s digital diary — tasks, costs, weather, and harvest, organised by year.
hero.sub: Oleachron keeps what you know, what you do, and what happens in the field — so every year leaves knowledge behind.
hero.trust: 1 field free · No complicated setup · No card required

promises.recordText: Tasks, observations, harvests, costs, and what you know about the field.
promises.dataText: Every entry lands on the right day, year, and growing season — automatically.
promises.passText: The knowledge stays with the grove — ready for whoever cares for it next.

problem.title: Years of knowledge don’t fit in a notebook.
problem.bridge: And after two or three years, the details fade.
problem.solution: Oleachron brings it all into one history that follows the grove itself.
problem.close: No more knowledge that lives only in memory.

brandMoment.title: Every year adds a new chapter.
brandMoment.intro: From the first tasks to harvest, every action becomes part of the grove’s story.

chronologio.title: Everything that happened in the grove. One story.
chronologio.text: Tasks, weather, observations, harvests, money, and field changes appear at the right moment.
chronologio.notesText: What you saw in the field.
chronologio.weatherText: What was happening when you decided.
chronologio.harvestText: What it cost, and what it returned.
chronologio.foot: And everything connects to the same field.

knowledge.title:
Data shows what happened.
You know why.
knowledge.p1: A sensor can record the rain.
knowledge.p2: Oleachron can also keep what only you know: why you sprayed, what you noticed, what you changed, and what you’d do differently.
knowledge.close: Technology complements your experience. It doesn’t replace it.

beforeAfter.title: One grove. One memory.
beforeAfter.close: Whatever belongs to the grove stays with the grove.

sharing.title: Knowledge stays with the field — not only with one person.
sharing.text: Family, agronomist, or partner can see what happened without starting from zero.
sharing.familyText: The next generation finds the story ready.
sharing.partnersText: The agronomist or worker has the context they need.
sharing.close: Knowledge becomes part of the field itself.

timeValue.title: Every year makes your grove clearer.
timeValue.close: As the history grows, decisions get better.

simpleUse.title: In the field, you need simplicity.
bullets: A photo when you need it
simpleUse.shotAlt: Logging a task from a phone

steps.title: Start today.
steps.lead: You don’t need to load your whole past into the system.

future.title:
You’re not just keeping a file.
You’re building continuity.
future.nextText: What did we learn, and what should change?
future.close: Oleachron turns records into experience that isn’t lost.

alpha.title: Start with your first grove free.
alpha.text: You don’t need to change how you work. Start with one field and watch its history grow.
alpha.trust: No card · Your data stays yours
alpha.downloadHint: Optional sideload for early testers. Most people should start on the web.
alpha.safetyWhy: This build is signed and hosted only on oleachron.com. Android will warn about unknown sources — that is normal for apps not yet on Play Store, not a sign of malware.
alpha.installTitle: How to install the trial app
installSteps: Download the file on your Android phone.
Allow installs from this source if asked.
Create an account or sign in.
alpha.safety: Install only from oleachron.com. Never from forwarded files or third-party sites.

demo.subtitle: Tell us about your groves and we’ll get in touch.
demo.name: Name
demo.message: What would you like to see?

cta.title: Your grove’s story has already begun.
cta.text: All that’s left is not to lose it.

footer.description: Your grove has knowledge. Oleachron makes sure it isn’t lost.
